summary: Frontend-only regression for WanderMark icon-system refactor (Build 84 prep). Verified all 4 target pages render correctly with new icon choices, navigation works, expand/collapse works, and no new console/page errors were introduced. Code inspection + live browser automation (Expo web build) both confirm icon-name changes are applied exactly as spec'd.

issues: Subtle-distinction risk: at 14 px on web, 'Verified' (shield-checkmark-outline, green) and 'Verified pts' (shield-checkmark filled, green) appear almost identical in the rendered Ionicons web font — both read as a small green circle with a white checkmark. The CODE uses the correct icon names, but the visual delta mentioned in the spec ('subtle but visible') is effectively invisible at 14 px on the web render. On native iOS/TestFlight the distinction should be clearer (vector rendering), but worth spot-checking on the real device build. Consider bumping the outline variant to a slightly different color/weight or using different-colored background chips if stakeholders report confusion.

action_items: No blocking action items. All icon changes rendered correctly and no regressions were observed.
OPTIONAL: On native build, re-verify the Verified vs Verified-pts shield distinction is visible to the naked eye. If not, differentiate via color/weight on the outline variant.

NOTE: Could not interactively exercise the small green shield-checkmark badge on photo thumbnails (line 87 of my-landmark-visits.tsx) because the onboarding/login gate prevented authenticated nav to visit cards during this run. Code inspection confirms the badge still uses shield-checkmark (filled) as intended. Safe per code review; main agent may self-verify post-login on device.
